fields.label: API Products
fields.help: List of API products associated with the developer app.

fields.label: Callback URL
fields.help: Callback URL used by OAuth 2.0 authorization servers to communicate authorization codes back to developer apps.

fields.label: Consumer Key
fields.help: Optionally specify a static consumer key for the developer app's credential.

fields.label: Consumer Secret
fields.help: Optionally specify a static consumer secret for the developer app's credential.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Key Expires In
fields.help: Expiration time, in milliseconds, for the consumer key that is generated for the developer app.

fields.label: Org ID
fields.help: The Apigee Organization associated with the Apigee instance, in the format 'organizations/{{org_name}}'.

fields.label: Scopes
fields.help: Scopes to apply to the developer app.
